features:
Key Features:

Marshmallow Magic: Includes colorful marshmallow shapes like stars, hearts, clovers, and moons—making it visually fun and appealing, especially for kids.

Whole Grain Base: Made with toasted whole grain oats, providing a source of whole grains in each serving.

Fortified with Vitamins & Minerals: Contains added nutrients like iron, calcium, vitamin D, and B vitamins to support daily nutritional needs.

Gluten-Free: Suitable for individuals with gluten sensitivity or celiac disease.

Ready-to-Eat Convenience: Requires no preparation—just pour and enjoy, making it ideal for busy mornings or quick snacks.

Benefits:

Kid-Friendly Appeal: The bright colors and marshmallow shapes encourage children to enjoy breakfast.

Nutritional Boost: Fortification with essential vitamins and minerals helps fill common dietary gaps, especially in children.

Quick and Easy Meal: Saves time in the morning with no cooking required—just add milk or enjoy dry as a snack.

Versatile: Can be eaten as breakfast, a school snack, or even used in dessert recipes like cereal bars or trail mixes.

Whole Grain Goodness: Includes a decent portion of whole grains, contributing to better digestion and heart health compared to refined grains.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Whole Grain Corn, Corn Starch, Corn Syrup, Dextrose. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Modified Corn Starch, Gelatin, Trisodium Phosphate, Red 40, Yellow 5 & 6, Blue 1, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness.Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
